head: 14bfd3ed63e906759a7e688068a1f8090bb74db7
scope: One combined new-delta correctness, clean-code, numerical/control-flow fidelity, boundary/FFI/memory/lifetime/concurrency/FPU and conformance-evidence review. Read-only source; no supplied tests, builds, native executables, campaigns, process/cache/auth or external actions run by reviewer; no delegation.

source_assessment.result: All new safe Rust entry points hold the existing all-map solver mutex across each C operation or complete conformance sweep. C saves/restores the FPU environment and selects FE_TOWARDZERO; nested conformance calls remain on the same map under that lock. Geometry ownership and map lifetime are reused, not reimplemented.

Below/above short circuits, sector-maximum-before-point-query order, original double literals, endpoint correction, ASSERT-predicate terrain read, midpoint order, squared-range stop, and final point read match the original source. World x/z extents are caller data; no universal campaign-grid/terrain-grid identity is introduced.

By-value record data and an optional existing opaque map hint are returned only when queried; no-read below answers have None, preserving caller record state. Invalid hints are checked lazily when read. Corrected above/below endpoints and impact are distinct values, allowing the actual below-output alias shape to be reconstructed without pointer export. Terrain-class vocabulary remains campaign-owned.

Counts, class-table cardinality/values and map extent are bounded. Fixed sample quotas fit the 12/32 arrays. C/Rust inner-field ordering and scalar widths were checked; actual x86_64 Windows executions exercise the boundary. No independent 32-bit ABI execution or claim is added.

The test embeds and parses actual repository-owned terrain enum/database texts; no private retail samples or handwritten class table are embedded. The independent c119 oracle is parsed as retained, not regenerated or normalized. All four physical folds, corresponding physical counters, class/type counts, endpoint diagnostics, semantic query/cache counters and 12+32 ordered samples are compared. A second entire host sweep must equal the first.

native_controller.scope: Recorded original controller/subprocess exits plus independently hashed raw logs and immutable payload/oracle identities; reviewer did not execute these tests.

evidence.preservation: All three original oracle hashes match the previously closed c119 originals. Original report repeats match after excluding only repeat_index and the separate repeat_identical control footer; original raw bytes were never rewritten. All per-run pre/post input logs are byte identical and contain IDENTICAL. Four current payload hashes match BUILD-INFO and controller.

limits: No production DLL/client/wn_move/public bridge wiring changed: this is host-kernel preparation, not a host-authoritative campaign cutover or delivered extraction.

Conformance compares original repeat 1 and independently asserts a full second host sweep is identical; the retained original 57-row measurements also match across repeats. It does not compare private legacy ground-record/ground-hash layout/index/pointer diagnostics.

The supplied retail Georgia and Lebanon worlds have equal world/terrain extents; an additional API test uses distinct world bounds. This does not establish every possible map/geometry/season or arbitrary world/Y input combination.

No new generic-provider/Lua/DLL protocol or public old-DLL authority refusal is implemented or tested here. No independent 32-bit execution, sanitizer run, DCS scheduling/performance or visual inspection claim is made.
Linux no-environment execution includes three explicitly skipped map-dependent functions; those are not counted as conformance. The later Windows map runs have four actual tests and no skips each.

Task47 final-source ordinary shipping validation remains pending and was untouched. No final shipping pack, Task47/Task48 delivery, integration merge, whole-D3 completion or GitHub APPROVED claim is made.
next_bounded_gates: No correction is required by this review of the pinned preparation delta.

After Task47 delivery/integration re-verification: review the new public G2 request/answer/record contract and all actual caller wiring/removal delta, preserve campaign class/world data ownership, and demonstrate a healthy old-DLL public authority RED before accepting the host cutover.

Collect candidate public/generic/refusal/default campaign and final-source ordinary shipping evidence for the eventual cutover. Continue remaining finite D3 responsibilities; do not infer completion from this kernel checkpoint.
review_setup_note: One reviewer-only repeat comparison initially included the extra repeat_identical footer in repeat 2; its assertion stopped before any report write. The comparison was corrected to the 57 actual ground-* measurement rows. This was not a source/build/native failure; no input, oracle, supplied checker or raw evidence changed.
